text:
Noah: quick ping on Nordly onboarding. PM reports intermittent slowdowns for batch document summarization during peak. renewal check in 2 weeks — want to be proactive.
Priya: are errors rising or just latency?
Noah: errors flat, but p95 has jumped from ~380ms to ~820ms after yesterday's content import.
Evan: likely KV churn + mixed seq lengths on same worker. short-term levers: 1) route long docs to a quantized large-context variant, 2) send short chat to a small fast model, 3) enable prefix KV caching. nonbreaking.
Marta: agree. proposed models: redwood/titan-14k-q4_0 for long docs, redwood/zephyr-3b-fast for chat. also enable X-Enable-KV header for session calls.
Priya: safe rollout plan?
Evan: canary 5% tonight, monitor p95/p99, error_rate, gpu_util, queue_length; if green after 30m, expand to 25%. auto-fallback to primary model on health failure. example routing rule to attach to their workspace:
```json
{"routes": [{"match": "metadata.intent == 'summarize' && tokens > 1000", "model": "redwood/titan-14k-q4_0", "weight": 0.05}, {"match": "tokens <= 1000", "model": "redwood/zephyr-3b-fast", "weight": 0.95}], "health_check": {"p95_ms": 700, "error_rate_pct": 1.0}, "fallback": "redwood/titan-14k-pt"}
```
Noah: can we estimate cost/quality impact to show the AM at renewal?
Evan: rough ballpark: summarization flows cost ~-30% compute with q4 quant, overall infra down ~-10% given mix. quality impact minimal on our evals, will run quick diffs.
Marta: i'll prep a one-pager for the renewal lead with rollback steps and expected metrics to capture (p50/p95/p99, error rate, cost per 1k tokens).
Priya: set up enablement call with Nordly eng + PM tomorrow 11am PT. Evan/Marta pls join to walk canary and config.
Evan: yes.
Marta: will record call and attach to customer record. also adding synthetic load script and prompt corpus to the runbook.
deploy-bot: Canary task queued: nordly-quant-route-canary (5%). status: pending approval.
Priya: approving now.
Noah: capturing customer feedback item: add telemetry link in UI when suggestions are slow so PMs can track UX impact.
Evan: added KV caching note and header examples in the runbook. also a small curl to toggle routing weights.
Marta: after canary we'll post pre/post metrics here and decide on 25% rollout. target: p95 reduction for affected flows ~40-60%.
Noah: thanks team. will update renewal tracker and include this blurb. :thumbsup:
